identity.name: Prospex Marinemaster 600m Professional Diver
identity.one_liner: The 600m saturation-diving Prospex reissue with a 47mm case, the 8L55 hi-beat movement, and a helium escape valve at 9 o'clock — a modern successor to the 6159-7001.

provenance_events.description: Seiko releases the SBDX101 as a 600m professional dive watch in the Prospex line — a 47mm steel case, ceramic bezel, helium escape valve, 8L55 hi-beat 36,000 vph movement.

narrative.story: The 6159-7001 was Seiko's 1968 saturation-diving watch — 600m, helium escape valve, 36,000 vph movement. The SBDX101 is the modern Prospex successor: same 600m, same 8L55 hi-beat architecture, modern case proportions.
narrative.collector_notes: The 8L55 is one of the few Seiko movements with a 55-hour reserve at 36,000 vph.
